name: mcp-schema-runner
description: Local developer tool for inspecting stdio MCP tool schemas and executing manual calls.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:ci: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && node --test scripts/processes.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
